exercises.prompt: Tell us about a time you applied for a job, course, or important opportunity.
Some people prefer a job with a high salary, while others prefer a job they find interesting. Which do you prefer, and why?
A young person is considering taking a gap year to work before starting university. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your local government is considering giving financial support to companies that hire young people with no work experience. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
